title: Ex-Beach Boy Al Jardine on Former Bandmate Mike Love’s Health: “It’s Shocking … He’s Trapped”
summary: Jardine, who's not in regular contact with Love, found himself "speechless" and "really depressed" when he saw the recent footage of Love onstage but knows the Beach Boys frontman doesn't want to stop performing: "He wants to be onstage, but he just doesn’t know how not to do it."
